placements.why: Establishes greenhouse sensing operations as an organizational category encompassing bay sensor rollout and telemetry cadence requirements.
placements.title: Systematic telemetry deployment across facility infrastructure
placements.frame: What operational and technical standards govern greenhouse environmental sensing and monitoring?

placements.title: Telemetry rollout targets historically vulnerable zones before seasonal environmental drops
placements.frame: How should environmental sensor installations and reporting cadences be prioritized across facilities to mitigate seasonal losses?
placements.why: Marchetti and Vasquez align on deploying humidity sensors across all four bays before first frost, piloting in bay two due to past winter seedling loss, with 15-minute reporting intervals to capture overnight drops.
